Figure 1. Illustration of Instance-Free DAOD. The orange time-
line indicates that target-domain instances appear only after a
long waiting period and require costly manual screening. Tradi-
tional DAOD (top) relies on target images containing foreground
instances, whereas Instance-Free DAOD (bottom) enables transfer-
ring using only background-only target images.
